goal: Gather ancestry information for all838 catalogue protocols as far as possible; add missing-predecessor audit and explicit review outcomes including external predecessors, source blockers, inability to assign formally, stronger inferred derivation and weaker guessed earlier chemistry analogues.

evidence_levels.documented: Explicit source attribution within stated method/component scope.
evidence_levels.inferred: Reasoned likely derivation, clearly qualified; not formal attribution.
evidence_levels.guessed: Looser earlier chemistry analogue, without established descent/inspiration; located evidence, date ordering and scope limits required.

completion_conditions: Every catalogue ID has a prior-curated, newly reviewed, explicitly source-blocked or justified not-applicable outcome; unreviewed candidate assessments remain pending.
Formal attribution is distinct from inference and guessing; no forced predecessor or universal independent-origin/absence claims.
External predecessor identities and actual original-source blockers recorded with original URLs and limits.
All accepted internal relationships form a valid known-ID graph; guesses have defensible earlier chronology.
Audit, review registry, full/local graph, similarity helper and ordinary offline website tests verified.
limits: Bounded max10minutes/three originals per protocol. A complete bounded ancestry pass is not full chemistry validation, exhaustive genealogy or a two-reader missing-information audit. Existing positive lineage curation is retained and labelled prior curation, not newly read originals.

verification.site: 598/598 builders;504 finished public schematics; all relative links and anchors resolve. Full build used --no-checks after separate shared suite.
verification.coverage: All838 current catalogue IDs have outcomes;732 new assigned IDs reconcile exactly without overlap;106 explicitly retained prior-curated records. --check-reviewed exits0.
verification.published_data: _site graph data/script match current generated outputs; invisible/private/illustrative endpoints stay withheld and are explained.
verification.limits: A complete bounded pass is not exhaustive historical genealogy, a full chemistry audit or an independent source-absence finding. Guessed analogues never become formal ancestors or molecular compatibility claims.

source_audit: 31 purported source blocks independently checked; six accessible originals reassessed, remaining identities/version gaps explicit.
identity_policy: Ancestry refers to the cited original method, never an invented experimental molecule. Known method DOIs map internally even if their molecular page is illustrative; public graph eligibility still withholds illustrative/private/notes pages. Distinct methods within one paper keep separate identities.
completed_features: Audit functions/CLI separate missing internal parent, missing formal attribution, unreviewed, source-blocked, external, inferred and guessed outcomes.
Per-protocol original-source availability/version records, external identities and inability to assign formally.
Distinct documented/inferred/guessed graph levels; optional gray-dotted guesses require earlier publication chronology.
Explainable IDF chemistry/sequence ranking with unknown coverage bounds, exact defining-DOI years and optional DOI-citation line pointers.
Method identities remain separate from invented molecular examples and physical material handoffs.
